# Spring Landscape Lighting: Landscape Lighting in Spring, TX

> Spring Landscape Lighting designs, installs and repairs custom low-voltage LED landscape lighting for homes in Spring, Klein, Champion Forest, Gleannloch Farms, Augusta Pines, The Woodlands and North Houston, TX. Phone (281) 704-7210.

## Services
- [Architectural Lighting](https://springlandscapelighting.com/services/architectural-lighting/): Bring dimension to brick, stone, columns, rooflines and entry features with carefully placed uplights, washes and grazing light.
- [Pathway & Driveway Lighting](https://springlandscapelighting.com/services/pathway-driveway-lighting/): Low-glare light along walks, steps and driveways that makes arrivals safer and feels welcoming, never like a runway.
- [Tree & Garden Lighting](https://springlandscapelighting.com/services/tree-garden-lighting/): Showcase live oaks, pines and planting beds with uplighting, moonlighting, silhouetting and soft accent light.
- [Patio & Pool Lighting](https://springlandscapelighting.com/services/patio-pool-lighting/): Comfortable light for patios, kitchens, pergolas, pools and fire features, so your outdoor rooms stay open after dark.
- [Smart Lighting Controls](https://springlandscapelighting.com/services/smart-lighting-controls/): Astronomical timers, zones, dimming and app control, so the right lights come on at the right time without you thinking about it.
- [Repairs & Upgrades](https://springlandscapelighting.com/services/landscape-lighting-repair/): Fix dim or dead fixtures, damaged wire and tired transformers, or convert an old halogen system to efficient LED.

## Free tools
- [Landscape Lighting Visualizer](https://springlandscapelighting.com/tools/lighting-visualizer/): Switch lighting layers on and off, change color temperature and brightness, and see how a home transforms after dark.
- [Energy Cost Calculator](https://springlandscapelighting.com/tools/energy-cost-calculator/): Estimate the nightly, monthly and yearly electricity cost of any landscape lighting system.
- [Fixture Count Estimator](https://springlandscapelighting.com/tools/fixture-estimator/): Describe your property and get a planning-level estimate of how many fixtures each area typically needs.
- [Transformer & Voltage Drop Calculator](https://springlandscapelighting.com/tools/transformer-sizing-calculator/): Size a low-voltage transformer and check voltage drop on a wire run before you buy or troubleshoot.
- [Halogen to LED Savings Calculator](https://springlandscapelighting.com/tools/led-savings-calculator/): Compare an existing halogen system with an LED retrofit: energy, cost and lamp replacements per year.
- [Color Temperature Explorer](https://springlandscapelighting.com/tools/color-temperature-guide/): Slide from candle-warm 2200K to cool 5000K and see which light color flatters brick, stone, foliage and water.
- [Sunset & Timer Planner](https://springlandscapelighting.com/tools/sunset-timer-planner/): Month-by-month sunset times for Spring, TX, with suggested timer settings and yearly run-hours.
